content.text:
## Complete File Contents

Here are the full contents of all seven files you requested:

### 1. HeroReel.tsx (260 lines)

`'use client'` component for the homepage autoplay video. Key features:
- Desktop: Vimeo player with autoplay, muted, looping
- Mobile: Static thumbnail only (no video player)
- Cinematic entrance with fade-in and scale animation
- Scroll-based pause/resume (desktop only)
- Dark overlay (#141414) that fades out when video starts playing
- 12-second initialization timeout
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` preference
- Hero height: 50vh mobile, 70vh desktop

### 2. ProjectHeroReel.tsx (252 lines)

Nearly identical to HeroReel.tsx but for project pages. Mirrors homepage behavior:
- Same Vimeo player setup
- Same scroll-based fade mechanics
- Mobile: Static thumbnail only
- Key difference: Fade starts at 30% of hero height (quicker fade on project pages)
- Same 12-second initialization timeout
- Same dark background (#141414, #141414) with overlay

### 3. Footer.tsx (148 lines)

Footer component with:
- **Left section:** Email (jomar.ibrahim@gmail.com) in --grey-500 with "Get in touch" label
- **Center:** Social icons (LinkedIn, Instagram, Vimeo) - 26x26px, --text-dim color
- **Right section:** Location (Brooklyn, NY) in --grey-500 with "Available worldwide" label
- **Bottom:** Copyright year dynamically generated
- All spacing uses CSS variables (--space-xl, --space-md, etc.)
- Uses DIN 2014 font for labels and location
- Hover opacity transitions to 60% opacity

### 4. ProjectGrid.tsx (182 lines)

Grid layout component with:
- Invisible shuffle strategy: adaptation applied silently, projects frozen during browsing
- Single-select discipline filtering (toggles on/off)
- Layout pattern: 1 hero card (full width) → 2-column grid for remaining projects
- Filter bar hidden (commented out with `false &&`)
- Displays filtered project count
- No results fallback with clear filters button

### 5. FilterBar.tsx (61 lines)

Hybrid filter bar (currently hidden in ProjectGrid):
- "All" button + category buttons
- Opacity transitions: active = 1.0, inactive = 0.5
- Uses --font-inter, uppercase, 13px, 0.06em letter spacing
- Single-select behavior (click same category to deselect)

### 6. ScrollReveal.tsx (68 lines)

Scroll-based entrance animation component:
- Triggers when element enters viewport (0.1 threshold, 20px margin)
- Opacity fade (0 → 1)
- Subtle translateY (15px → 0)
- 400ms duration with cubic-bezier easing
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
- Optional `delay` prop for staggered animations

### 7. projectColors.ts (61 lines)

Project color system:
- **getProjectBackgroundColor():** HSL colors based on project type (Feature Film, Commercial, Music Video, etc.)
- Base lightness: 9.4% (#181818) with subtle variation per index
- **getProjectAccentColor():** Complementary accent colors or default #FFB000
- **getProjectDividerColor():** Subtle border colors
- Color palettes include hue/saturation for 8 project types
- Default neutral palette for untyped projects

All files are part of the production codebase on branch `dark-theme-with-chat`.
